secureFeatures.title: Protected video lessons
secureFeatures.text: Every video is delivered through secure, enrollment-gated streaming with user watermarks.

secureFeatures.title: Course access control
secureFeatures.text: Only enrolled students can open paid lessons, quizzes, and downloadable materials.

secureFeatures.title: Personalized content
secureFeatures.text: Each student gets their own private view of the course, progress, and results.

secureFeatures.title: Student-only resources
secureFeatures.text: PDFs and supplementary materials are issued exclusively to enrolled students.

secureFeatures.text: Your answers, scores, and learning history stay tied to your account only.
